ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform to automatically detect and flag industrial environmental compliance violations for local regulatory bodies.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by blending practical civic utility with satellite computer vision, which appeals directly to pragmatic problem-solving hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Graph-intelligence and risk-investigation platform designed to trace supply chain fund flows and flag illicit agricultural subsidies.
ideas.title: AgriGuard-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies hardcore graph intelligence and anomaly detection techniques similar to Bito, giving technical judges a complex, working engineering artifact.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient trust engine that ingests clinical case histories to automatically generate empathetic, verified treatment previews for specialized dental clinics.
ideas.title: MediTrust-Acquisition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Modeled precisely on Global-Smile's winning formula of combining niche healthcare workflows with rapid LLM integration for high conversion impact.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student advisory platform leveraging RAG and LangGraph to dynamically route administrative and academic queries across university departments.
ideas.title: EcoCampus-Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the architecture of GreenNovation's 1st place multi-agent platform, addressing tangible institutional efficiency which academic-adjacent hackathon judges favor.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and probabilistic incident forecasting dashboard that predicts regional infrastructure supply bottlenecks based on historical weather and traffic data.
ideas.title: RiskCast-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the statistically rigorous forecasting mechanics seen in Apart Research's AI-incident winner, showcasing real math rather than just wrapper UI.
